[SCOPE] This fictional policy covers periodic reviews of high-risk customer records. Low-risk customers follow a separate schedule.

[DEFINITION] A high-risk customer is a customer assigned the HIGH category in the approved risk register. A large account balance alone does not establish this category.

[INTERVAL] Review high-risk customer records every 12 months. Apply the documented exception in clause EXCEPTION before scheduling a review.

[EXCEPTION] A high-risk customer with a documented temporary review exemption follows Annex A. Annex A is not included in this corpus; do not infer its schedule.

[OWNER] The customer review team owns periodic review scheduling.

[RETENTION] Keep review completion evidence in the approved evidence register.

sources.text:
[SCOPE] This fictional policy covers periodic reviews of high-risk customer records. Low-risk customers follow a separate schedule.

[DEFINITION] A high-risk customer is a customer assigned the HIGH category in the approved risk register. A large account balance alone does not establish this category.

[INTERVAL] Review high-risk customer records every 6 months. Apply the documented exception in clause EXCEPTION before scheduling a review.

[EXCEPTION] A high-risk customer with a documented temporary review exemption follows Annex A. Annex A is not included in this corpus; do not infer its schedule.

[RETENTION] Keep review completion evidence in the approved evidence register.

[OWNER] The periodic review operations team owns review scheduling.

[ESCALATION] Escalate overdue high-risk reviews to the periodic review operations lead within 5 business days.

[SCHEDULE] Schedule high-risk customer record reviews every 12 months.

[ASSIGN] Route review scheduling to the customer review team.

[CHECK] Check the approved risk register for the customer category. Customers with an exemption need manual investigation of Annex A.

[SCHEDULE] Schedule high-risk customer record reviews every 6 months, except documented temporary exemptions governed by Annex A.

[ASSIGN] Route scheduling to the periodic review operations team.

[ESCALATE] Escalate overdue high-risk reviews to the periodic review operations lead within 5 business days.

[SCHEDULE] Schedule low-risk customer record reviews every 12 months. This procedure does not cover HIGH-category customers.

[OWNER] The customer service team owns low-risk review scheduling.
[SCHEDULE] Future draft: schedule high-risk customer record reviews every 3 months. This is not available in October.
[SCHEDULE] Unverified timing: schedule high-risk customer reviews monthly. The effective date is unknown.
